scope: Existing five phone recordings; read-only dataset/trace checks without model inference or final outcomes.
methods: Compare every state/action float32 row in exported Parquet to its source NPZ, by episode_index and frame_index.
SHA256-match original NPZ and JSON copies, all five source videos, source traces, metadata and export files.
For recovery, verify the first labelled state equals the saved takeover state, expert phase labels cover all exported rows, and no exported state/action pair equals an unlabelled prefix pair.
Check original and added episode coverage, frozen top-level training seeds, and no overlap with either new-development or final seed ranges.
limitations: Equal episode counts and update budgets do not imply equal frame counts or equal epochs; frame counts differ among arms.
Twenty recovery takeovers come from five correlated failed policy rollouts, not twenty independent failure scenarios.
Recovery/grasp/release labels come from a simulator expert; only carry-path shape and timing derive from existing human video.
Prefix reproduction verifies observed robot state, cube position and applied actions; it does not independently compare all latent MuJoCo state variables.
Camera PNG content was not decoded or pixel-compared in this audit; numeric state/action rows and file provenance were checked.
No training or final evaluation outcomes were used in this audit.
